name: B10-0219/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Immediate risk of further repression by Lukashenka’s regime in Belarus - threats from the Investigative Committee
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the immediate risk of further repression by Lukashenka’s regime in Belarus – threats from the Investigative Committee
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It condemns Belarus's authorities for pursuing Belarusians who have fled abroad, including through "special proceedings" opened against hundreds of them. It asks the European Union and its member states to protect Belarusians in exile, make visas and residence permits easier to get, and plan for people who cannot renew identity documents. It also calls for all political prisoners to be freed.

- No law changes; Parliament asks the EU to act and condemns Belarus's cross-border repression.
- It affects Belarusians in exile in the EU and those trying to leave Belarus.
- Next: the EU and member states are asked to ease visas, permits and identity papers.
